additional_info.subject: RE: ID0476821/DC/Si-D/IT-[Multiple] Check on logs CRM:02681001396
additional_info.body:
Dear Mrs. Abate,
I hope you are doing well. Thank you for contacting Technical support team. After thoroughly checked the timestamp you have provided.
For the first incident (
170002555):
there was a server related issue. OCPP send command to authenticate but the server didn´t response in time.
From the log we can see:
Heartbeats succeed
Indicates that the TCP/TLS session is alive.
✔ Only the Authorize response is missing
This points to selective packet loss or backend delay — not a full outage.
✔ Timestamp gap (≈15 seconds) exactly matches the authorization timeout window
Which is standard (usually 10 or 15 seconds).
Now about the second charger (
170002651):
We have find out some issue which fixed in latest FW version. I kindly request you to update the charger to latest version.
Let me know, if you have further question. Otherwise a quick feedback will be very helpful to close the ticket.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
